notes.browser_transform: The browser uses a validated affine approximation only for selecting the debug grid cell. Core Python queries continue to use pyproj.
notes.no_data: -99 is treated as invalid/no-data, never as 0 mm.

notes.crs: NCDR metadata labels coordinates as lon/lat but does not explicitly name the CRS. This debug slice currently treats them as directly comparable with route WGS84 coordinates pending spatial cross-check.
notes.scope: Only the Taiwan-main-island validation bounds are published to keep the public debug payload compact; the raw NCDR CSV is never published.
